additionalDocuments.label: One River Point original project brief (Mitchell’s mirror)

review.gallery: Eight project-specific developer renders and two October 2026 site photographs. The wider official web exterior leads the gallery and card so the tower top fits the landscape frame.
review.location: The marked developer aerial shows the canal frontage and Al A’amal Street. JRE and Dubainary publish the same approximate project point. Nineteen estimates follow the project brief driving table.
review.floorPlans: Fifty-eight drawings: 20 complete residence sheets including both duplex levels and all three penthouse types, ten typical plates, four amenity sheets, three parking drawings from the developer app and 21 numbered original unit diagrams via Property Finder. Eight generic Property Finder mirrors duplicate brochure layouts and are omitted. Unit-specific diagrams lack area totals. Brochure examples retain their printed figures, including 0.01 sq ft component differences.

unavailable: Separate drawings for residential floor 17 and basement levels, a verified visitor entrance and completed project photography.
